scenes.name: suburb
scenes.title: Suburban houses
scenes.desc: 8 detached houses of different styles (bungalow, colonial, cottage, flat-roof modern, hip roof with wing, Tudor), with fences, driveways, yards, a pool, a community green and footpaths.

scenes.name: courtyard
scenes.title: Apartment courtyard
scenes.desc: A courtyard enclosed by apartment blocks and row houses, with a playground, a car park and street trees.

scenes.name: mainstreet
scenes.title: Main street
scenes.desc: 14 shops along both sides, a crossroads, zebra crossings, traffic lights and parked vehicles.

scenes.name: campus
scenes.title: Campus
scenes.desc: Four teaching buildings around a central lawn, with a pond and footpaths.

scenes.name: industrial
scenes.title: Industrial area
scenes.desc: A factory, warehouses, storage tanks, a container yard and chimneys inside a chain-link compound.
